title: The Empty Will
author: Oscar Brightwater
blurb: Ines Halloran, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
